# BPMN Desk 0.6.0

- **Flowable execution history linked to the diagram.** Find finished or ongoing instances and inspect individual activity visits, loops, parallel multi-instance tasks and called processes on their exact deployed BPMN version. Select a journal entry to locate it on the diagram, or select an element to filter its visits. Inspect recorded times, assignees, termination reasons and saved variables with their task/execution scopes.
- **Current state and history on one canvas.** The diagram combines recorded visits with confirmed runtime positions. Switch between **Current state** and **Execution history** in the right panel without losing diagram zoom or selection. Runtime and history remain independently available when the other API is unavailable; SVG/PNG exports include the combined markers.
- **Navigate between related processes.** Parent and child cards show the process name, business key/name and instance ID. Monitor toolbar back/forward buttons offer destination previews and support mouse side-button commands on Linux and Windows. Each monitor has its own navigation history.
- **More space for the diagram.** Collapse either panel using its bottom tab. Selecting another element keeps hidden details collapsed and gently marks the tab as updated. Legends and snapshot times occupy one row, with explanations in hover/keyboard tooltips.
- **Canvas interaction fixes.** Vertical/horizontal scrolling and wheel zoom work over badges. The bpmn.io logo remains fully visible beside the panel tab and no longer overlaps it. Reopening a selected dead-letter job returns to its error details.

History requires retained Flowable history and API access. A missing end time does not confirm an active step, and a recorded end does not establish success. Partial results are marked; saved variables contain their latest recorded values rather than values at a selected visit. Routes are highlighted only when sequence flows were recorded. Navigation retains up to 100 destinations per direction in memory per monitor.

Linux AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` are built and tested by GitHub Actions. Windows executables are unsigned; manual installer acceptance is not confirmed. macOS is not available.
